card.name: Food and cooking text, mid-name or mid-list
card.fires_on: Unfinished spots in food and cooking writing, such as partway through a cook's name, a food word or a nutrition number. The setting is recipes, cookbooks, and nutrition facts.

modes.label: Cook and author names
modes.description: Inside or just after a first name of a chef, test cook or cookbook author.

modes.label: Recipe descriptions
modes.description: Partway through words describing meat or ingredients in a recipe.

modes.label: Nutrition numbers
modes.description: Inside numbers or ranges in nutrient amounts.
modes.example: 8 g of fiber and 37<<0>> milligrams of sodium.

card.writes: It pushes toward food, taste, texture, and nutrition words, and away from cloth and fabric words.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of names, words and numbers in cooking and nutrition writing, getting ready for a food-related word.
